name: presenter-mobile
description: Worship lyrics presentation system — mobile controller + projected display
author: PraisePresenter

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "vite" "NODE_ENV=development tsx watch server/index.ts"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && node scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-electron.mjs && electron-builder --linux --publish never
